target_customer: Companies and technical teams that want a self-hostable AI chat and enterprise search layer over internal tools
problem: Employees cannot find answers spread across Slack, Drive, Confluence, GitHub and Salesforce, and many firms cannot send confidential data to closed cloud tools.
business_model: Open source core (MIT) with paid cloud and proprietary enterprise edition
product_category: Open source enterprise search and AI assistant

founders.name: Chris Weaver
founders.background_notes: Team lead at Robinhood; former top 100 North American League of Legends player per YC page.

founders.name: Yuhong Sun
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in press; background not captured from fetched sources.

technical_complexity.rationale: Hybrid search with permission syncing across dozens of connectors, plus model agnostic chat, was a substantial engineering effort for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Open source adoption and many connectors create community pull and integration depth, but large platforms could ship similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Zoom acquired Onyx in autumn 2026 and said it would continue as a standalone open source platform serving data sovereignty customers.

market_need_then: Enterprise search over scattered SaaS data was a recognized pain, and the open source plus self-host angle addressed confidentiality concerns around closed LLM tools; demand evidence is visible in GitHub traction reported later.

branding.name_origin: Onyx was renamed from Danswer, which TechCrunch describes as a portmanteau for deep answer; the reason for choosing Onyx is not stated.
branding.brand_signature: Open source with reportedly 26,000 to 30,000 GitHub stars

rebrands.why: Not stated by sources; one site says it followed commercial scaling, unconfirmed.

branding.community_and_virality: Large open source GitHub following (over 26,000 stars per a third party page, over 30,000 per deal coverage) and a Launch HN post.

brand_strength.rationale: Open source community and press gave visibility, but the name is generic and shares its name with several other products.

pivots.to: Onyx open source AI chat UI connected to company knowledge
pivots.why: Not stated explicitly; the product emphasis moved from search to chat and agents.

outcome_analysis: Onyx, formerly Danswer, grew through open source distribution, reaching tens of thousands of GitHub stars and a 20 person team, then raised a 10 million dollar seed led by Khosla and First Round in March 2025. In autumn 2026 Zoom acquired it for undisclosed terms to gain a self-hostable enterprise context layer. The exit follows traction and strategic fit rather than distress.
notes: Seed confirmed by the company release, FinSMEs and TechCrunch. Earlier small amounts (about 130K to 500K from Pioneer Fund, YC, Eight Capital) appear only on aggregators and are unverified. Zoom deal date conflicts across sources (September 23, October 23, November 8, 2026). Competitor search returned only 2026 Glean alternative lists, so the dated list is empty. Whether the 2023 company was Danswer under the same entity is per CB Insights and press.
